handshake.proof: device signature over authenticated user/device/connection/purpose/session/incarnation and fresh 32-byte challenge
handshake.authorization: active approved owner device or explicit current member; host output only from the publication's hosting device

checkpoint.payload: AES-GCM encrypted native terminal checkpoint followed by optional bounded JSON terminal metadata (directory, title, program; maximum 16384 bytes); metadata is consumed only from freshness-verified captures

bootstrap.gapPolicy: fresh host checkpoint or retryable close; never substitute a plain presentation

freshnessProof.challengeAuthority: requesting endpoint; generated anew for initial connection and every capture refresh
freshnessProof.encoding: UTF-8 text or bytes, each preceded by u32be byte length, following TERMINAL_CHECKPOINT_PROOF_V1 domain
freshnessProof.verification: verify current challenge, exact recipient/publication, host signature and encrypted frame digest before releasing checkpoint or advancing replay state

controls.resultAuthority: signed host result correlated with the exact current connection and request

freshness.revocation: ready=false durably before invalidation; current revision and key generation required before serving again
freshness.hostReconnect: fresh key generation before restarting counters
freshness.identityReplacement: never silently trust a replacement pinned identity
freshness.expiredPublicationRecovery: same still-live local session; fresh key and connections; owner devices only until friends explicitly selected again

presence.meaning: Backend-reported current participant presence; not an authorization grant or cryptographic identity claim
presence.lifetime: Cleared on host disconnect or access rotation; deduplicated by user for display

metadataRefresh.contents: No metadata or authority; only an invalidation hint from the current host to ready participants
metadataRefresh.delivery: Host coalesces changes; participant coalesces fresh capture requests. Idle sessions do not poll.
metadataRefresh.verification: Metadata is consumed only after existing challenge-bound host checkpoint proof verification.

termination.boundary: finalSequence must equal the delivered raw continuation; queued output drains before viewer sockets close

connectionRetirement.retiredIds: Fixed-size replay rejection filter; no false negatives, possible fail-closed false positives only for a new connection
connectionRetirement.isolation: Retired controls are discarded without disconnecting unrelated viewers
